shared_elements: upright rectangular stone slab carved in low relief
row of repeated motifs along the upper edge
raised carved elements against a flat recessed ground
justification: Both are tall, tan stone panels worked in shallow relief with a horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper zone and figural elements arranged in registers below, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a finely, evenly cut composition dominated by a rayed disc, human figures at an offering table and a dense grid of tiny script covering most of the field, while B is coarse, sparse and irregular, with large isolated animal forms and no writing or human figures at all.
